blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa al-Aslami (RA)
blocks.tamil_translation: came out and said, “Whoever has some need, whether that need concerns Allah or concerns His creation, let him make Wudu and pray two rak'ahs, and then make the Du'a (لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ الْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ سُبْحَانَ اللهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اَللّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْئَلُكَ مُوجِبَاتِ رَحْمَتِكَ وَعَزَائِمَ مَغْفِرَتِكَ وَالْغَنِيمَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ بِرٍّ وَالسَّلَامَةَ مِنْ كُلِّ إِثْمٍ أَسْئَلُكَ أَلَّا تَدَعَ لِي ذَنْباً إِلَّا غَفَرْتَهُ وَلَا هَمّاً إِلَّا فَرَّجْتَهُ وَلَا حَاجَةً هِيَ لَكَ رِضاً إِلَّا قَضَيْتَهَا لِي) “There is none worthy of worship except Allah, the Most Forbearing, the Most Noble. Allah is free from every imperfection. He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne. All praise belongs to Allah, the Lord of all the worlds'. O Allah, I ask You for all the things that make Your mercy certain and the things that make Your forgiveness sure. I ask You for a share in every good and safety from every sin. Do not leave any sin of mine without forgiving it! Do not leave any worry without removing it! Do not leave any need of mine that is pleasing to You without fulfilling it!” After this, whatever matter of this world or the Hereafter he asks Allah for, he will be given it.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa al-Aslami (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ told us this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَي النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَقَالَ: يَارَسُولَ اللهِ! إِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَخْرُجَ إِلَي الْبَحْرَيْنِ فِي تِجَارَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله موثقون مجمع الزوائد:٥٧٢/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “A man came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ and said, “O Messenger of Allah! I wish to go to Bahrain to trade.”
